Recorded selection note: “Bay of Bengal pilot model; see source and mapping notes for coverage.” Comparative reasons were not recorded.

Balanced Table 16 parameters are reproduced; whole-area biomass uses habitat fraction × habitat biomass. Published diet columns contain omissions (Table 17; Appendix A3.2). The JSON normalizes nonzero columns and inserts a detritus diet for all-zero 3 Meiobenthos.
These transformations change production closure by up to 77.3%; the constructor derives biomass accumulation to close the transformed input and sets detritus EE to 1. Derived BA is not an observation. Native author-model fidelity remains unverified.

Geographic evidence and area calculation

The static model represents 1978; retained catch series spans 1950–2019 and the validation reference is 2019. Fixed model coefficients and pooled 1978 total-catch weights assume stable food-web structure, taxon composition and fishery geography across years and catch bases.
Model-derived estimates remain provisional because source diet reconstruction and derived BA are unresolved. Numerical reproducibility does not establish author-native balance.
